name: Stuck in You
source:
Once inseparable, Ninoa and Min-joo shared a bond deeper than most until an act of betrayal shattered their trust. When Ninoa stole Min-joo's [s]shitty[/s] boyfriend, the rift between them seemed impossible to mend. But fate has a peculiar way of reuniting old friends. 

Now, trapped together in an elevator at their workplace, they're forced to confront their past face-to-face. Will they mend what they had, or will old wounds prove too deep?

[From [url=https://llonelly.itch.io/stuck-in-you]itch.io[/url]]
